style: splice (Forge-like, short lead, loop out after the hit)

tempos.note: bar_period_s = 72.577 / 36 so the loop wraps in exactly 36 bars. 119.05 BPM would be 2.015959681 s/bar (68 µs short).

hit.snap: Yes — 2.65 ms before the 61.441 label, within the 15 ms window. Max 1 ms-energy rise of the cymbal/drum attack at 61.438354 s (sample 2949041). Librosa backtrack onset was 61.437333 s. The first large peak is 61.438833 s. The label sits in the middle of the attack.

loop_grid.method: Kick-band (30–150 Hz) envelope max-rise, seeded by hop-128 STFT kick onsets on layer B.
loop_grid.drift_note: Slight tempo drift: early bars ~-27 ms, mid (8–20, this splice) ~-20 ms, late ~-17 ms. A constant bar_phase_s cannot track every bar. bar_phase_s is taken from the splice bar (bar 15, -20.23 ms), which matches the mid-loop median, so the engine T at this loop position equals the measured kick used in the demo. Residuals at the loop extremes are about 8 ms.

mix.note: Boss/heat mix. _forge_set_heat applies FORGE_A_BOSS_LIN (0.5) to bed A on every layered biome, including Crystal Cavern, when heat is on. Dungeon-clear victory is after the boss. Layer C is a quiet stem (+10 dB still ~23 dB under A); it is included because the game plays it during heat.

loudness.loop_section: boss mix, demo region, bar 8 kick through bar 15 kick
loudness.outro_body: extend 61.438354–66.5 s (post-hit body, before the long tail fade)

victory_clip.fade_in_baked: linear 0→1 over the first 30 ms, full at the hit

crystal_cavern.note: bar_phase_s = measured bar-15 kick minus 15×bar_period_s. Negative means downbeats are early of a t=0 grid. Do not also bake this into outro_lead_s.

crystal_cavern_victory.note: Clip has baked 30 ms linear fade-in + -9.7 dB loudness match; engine gain_db 0. Start the clip outro_lead_s (0.030) before the engine bar line T. Hold A/B/C through the lead; linear 1→0 over 50 ms (loop_out_frac×bar) starting at T.

wiring_maps_to_demo.rule: Engine T at this loop position MUST equal the demo hit. outro_lead_s is only the pre-roll. Do not add bar_phase_s a second time into the lead (Crypt #505 lesson).
wiring_maps_to_demo.engine_T: k * bar_period_s + bar_phase_s. At loop position of bar 15, T = 15 * 2.016027777777778 + (-0.020229166666666667) = 30.2201875 s, which is the measured kick (sample 1450569).
wiring_maps_to_demo.demo_T: 14.1183541667 s = T_loop - loop_start = 30.2201875 - 16.1018333333. The snapped extend hit (61.4383541667) is placed exactly here.
wiring_maps_to_demo.engine_clip_start: T - outro_lead_s = T - 0.030. Clip sample 0 is extend 61.4083541667; clip sample 1440 (0.030 s) is the hit, already at full baked gain.
wiring_maps_to_demo.engine_loop_out: loop_out_start='bar' means hold_s = lead_s, so the 50 ms ramp starts at T (not at clip start, and not ending at T like Forge splice_out_s 0.04). Loop is full at the hit and silent at T+0.050.
wiring_maps_to_demo.do_not: Do not set lead_in_frac or splice_out_s for this bed. Those are the Forge path (half-bar lead, loop silent AT T). Do not set bar_phase_s to 0 and also shift the clip. Do not apply FORGE-style 0.5 lead_in_frac.
